name: Fresh Calendars News Desk
bio: The Fresh Calendars News Desk covers the dates that shape everyday planning in the United States, with some coverage of the United Kingdom and Canada: federal and state holidays, daylight saving time, Social Security and Medicare deadlines, election dates and voting rules, religious and cultural calendars, sky events, school calendars and retail dates. Every date is checked against a primary source such as a government notice, an official agency calendar, the U.S. Naval Observatory or the maker's own website, and each story links to the printable calendar or holiday page it updates. Many stories include free printable templates made by Fresh Calendars. Corrections are noted at the end of the article with the date they were made.
